A research-track training on working with precipitation indicators in R or Python. Covers the conceptual basics of gridded precipitation products and walks through extracting area-level indicators for analysis.

**Planned content:**

- Sources of precipitation data and their trade-offs
- Extracting area-level indicators from gridded products
- Defining and computing extreme precipitation events
- Linking precipitation indicators to vulnerability and exposure
